```ts
// Vendored from shared/types/domain/overview.ts — captured 2026-07-08 (BIOS-002). Do not edit without re-verifying against the live server.

/**
 * Overview 2.0 — shared API types
 */

export interface OverviewExpectedImpact {
  label: string;
  delta: string;
}

export interface OverviewDailyBrief {
  headline: string;
  opportunity: string | null;
  risk: string | null;
  focusAreas: string[];
  dayScore: number | null;
  expectedImpacts: OverviewExpectedImpact[];
}

export interface OverviewLifeScoreComponent {
  score: number | null;
  weight: number;
  label: string;
}

export interface OverviewLifeScore {
  totalScore: number | null;
  components: OverviewLifeScoreComponent[];
  dimensionScores: Record<string, number | null>;
}

export interface OverviewPriority {
  id: string;
  action: string;
  impact: string;
  pillar: string;
  priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  source: 'daily_report' | 'graph' | 'task' | 'plan' | 'coach';
}

export interface OverviewLifeAreaSnapshot {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  domainType: string;
  linkCount: number;
  metricLabel?: string;
  metricValue?: string;
  progress?: number;
  href: string;
}

export type OverviewJourneyStatus = 'completed' | 'active' | 'upcoming' | 'skipped';

export type OverviewScheduleItemSource = 'manual' | 'google' | 'prayer' | 'plan';

export interface OverviewJourneyItem {
  id: string;
  time: string;
  endTime?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  pillar: string;
  status: OverviewJourneyStatus;
  href?: string;
  actionId?: string;
  source?: 'plan' | 'task' | 'schedule';
  planId?: string;
  scheduleId?: string;
  scheduleItemSource?: OverviewScheduleItemSource;
  externalId?: string;
  durationMinutes?: number;
}

export interface OverviewDimensionScore {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: number | null;
  color: string;
}

export interface OverviewInsight {
  id: string;
  headline: string;
  body: string;
  pillars: string[];
}

export interface OverviewMomentum {
  streak: number;
  xp: number;
  level: number;
  levelName: string;
  weeklyTrend: number[];
  weeklyDelta: number | null;
  /** Habits marked complete today; null when the user tracks no habits. */
  habitsCompleted: number | null;
  /** Active habit count; null when the user tracks no habits. */
  habitsTotal: number | null;
  /** % of active goals on track; null when the user has no active goals. */
  weeklyGoalProgress: number | null;
}

export interface OverviewFeatureChip {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  href: string;
  pillar: string;
}

/**
 * Canonical life domain score (Life Balance Wheel + Life Domains grid).
 * `score: null` + `status: 'no_data'` means the user has no signal for that domain yet —
 * we render an honest "start tracking" state rather than a fabricated number.
 */
export interface OverviewDomainScore {
  id: string; // health|fitness|nutrition|wellbeing|career|finance|relationships|goals
  label: string;
  score: number | null;
  status: 'strong' | 'steady' | 'attention' | 'no_data';
  weeklyDelta: number | null;
  caption: string;
  href: string;
  accent: 'orange' | 'green' | 'purple';
  /** Recent score history for the card sparkline (oldest→newest). null when no trend available. */
  trend?: number[] | null;
}

/** A discovered cross-domain correlation (Correlation Engine). */
export interface OverviewCorrelation {
  id: string;
  fromLabel: string;
  toLabel: string;
  impactPct: number; // signed
  direction: 'positive' | 'negative';
  confidence: number; // 0-1
  source: 'lcm' | 'daily_report';
}

/** Relationship hub summary. */
export interface OverviewRelationshipTouchpoint {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  when: string;
  accent: 'orange' | 'purple' | 'amber';
}

/** A conversation the user is actively engaged in (Relationship Hub "Top Conversations"). */
export interface OverviewTopChat {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  avatar: string | null;
  isGroup: boolean;
  /** Messages exchanged in the last 30 days. */
  messageCount: number;
  /** Human label for recency, e.g. "2h ago" · "Yesterday" · "3d ago". null when unknown. */
  lastActiveLabel: string | null;
  /** Unread messages for this user in this chat. */
  unread: number;
  /** Deep link into the chat surface. */
  href: string;
}

export interface OverviewRelationshipsSummary {
  totalActive: number;
  overdue: number;
  healthScore: number | null; // 0-100; null when no real cadence/recency/chat signal
  daysSinceLastConnection: number | null;
  topConnections: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    photoUrl: string | null;
    overdue: boolean;
    strength: 'very_strong' | 'strong' | 'steady' | 'reach_out';
  }>;
  /** People & groups the user messages most — primary content of the hub card. */
  topChats: OverviewTopChat[];
  /** Total messages exchanged across top conversations in the last 30 days. */
  activeConversations: number;
  touchpoints: OverviewRelationshipTouchpoint[];
  networkDelta: number | null;
  href: string;
}

/** Finance snapshot summary. */
export interface OverviewFinanceSpendingSlice {
  label: string;
  amount: number;
  pct: number;
  color: string;
}

export interface OverviewFinanceSummary {
  currency: string;
  monthlySpend: number;
  vsLastMonthPct: number | null;
  budgetStatus: 'on_track' | 'warning' | 'exceeded' | 'unset';
  savingsProgressPct: number | null;
  financialGoalLabel: string | null;
  healthScore: number | null; // 0-100; null when no real income/expense to compute
  totalIncome: number;
  netSavings: number;
  savingsRatePct: number | null;
  cashFlowDeltaPct: number | null;
  spendingSlices: OverviewFinanceSpendingSlice[];
  expenseTrend: number[];
  /** Parallel month labels for expenseTrend (e.g. "Mar", "Last", "Now"). */
  expenseTrendLabels: string[];
  netWorthEstimate: number | null;
  emergencyFundMonths: number | null;
  debtToIncomePct: number | null;
  financialFreedomPct: number | null;
  href: string;
}

/** Goals overview summary. */
export interface OverviewGoalsSummary {
  activeCount: number;
  onTrack: number;
  atRisk: number;
  offTrack: number;
  missionScore: number;
  topGoals: Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    progress: number;
    status: 'on_track' | 'at_risk' | 'off_track';
    dueLabel: string | null;
    priority: 'top' | 'next' | 'other';
  }>;
  /** Avg progress per life-goal category for the radar chart. */
  goalsByArea: Array<{
    id: string;
    label: string;
    value: number;
    color: string;
  }>;
  href: string;
}

/** Upcoming schedule item. */
export interface OverviewScheduleItem {
  id: string;
  time: string;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  status: OverviewJourneyStatus;
  href?: string;
}

/**
 * Life Pulse — the hero card's living vitals (energy · recovery · stress).
 *
 * Honesty rule: every metric maps to a real signal. Recovery/stress prefer the
 * wearable (WHOOP); when absent we compute from app data (sleep, mood, workout,
 * nutrition, self-reports) and mark `source: 'computed'`. A metric with no
 * underlying signal returns `value: null` and the card dims it rather than
 * inventing a number.
 */
export type OverviewPulseAccent = 'orange' | 'amber' | 'green';

export type OverviewPulseTone = 'good' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'bad' | 'none';

export interface OverviewPulseMetric {
  key: 'energy' | 'recovery' | 'stress';
  label: string;
  /** 0-100. null = no signal. For stress, higher = more stress. */
  value: number | null;
  /** Human display, e.g. "84%" or "—". */
  display: string;
  /** Qualitative band, e.g. "High" | "Good" | "Low" | "Moderate" | "Elevated". */
  qualityLabel: string;
  /** Colour intent for the band label (decouples client from thresholds). */
  qualityTone: OverviewPulseTone;
  /** Signed change vs ~a week ago (percentage points). null when no history. */
  delta: number | null;
  /** Whether a positive delta is a good thing (false for stress). */
  positiveIsGood: boolean;
  /** Sparkline series, oldest→newest, 0-100. Empty when no history. */
  trend: number[];
  /** Short human caption, e.g. "Sustained energy throughout the day". */
  caption: string;
  source: 'whoop' | 'self_report' | 'computed';
  accent: OverviewPulseAccent;
}

export interface OverviewPulse {
  /** Mirror of lifeScore.totalScore for the hero ring (0-100). null = no data yet (honest empty). */
  score: number | null;
  /** Life-balance change vs last week (percentage points). null when no history. */
  scoreDelta: number | null;
  /** Dynamic headline, e.g. "You're in a great place". */
  tone: string;
  /** Sub-sentence, e.g. "Energy is high, recovery is strong, and you're building great momentum." */
  summary: string;
  /** Phrase within `summary` to emphasise (rendered in brand colour). null = none. */
  summaryAccent: string | null;
  /** Always [energy, recovery, stress]; any `value` may be null. */
  metrics: OverviewPulseMetric[];
  /** "Tip for you" footer copy. null when nothing useful to surface. */
  tip: string | null;
  /** True when at least one metric is sourced from a connected wearable. */
  hasWearable: boolean;
}

export interface OverviewMeta {
  generatedAt: string;
  hasDailyReport: boolean;
  hasLifeAreas: boolean;
  hasCoachingProfile: boolean;
  activeDomainCount: number;
  hasFinance: boolean;
  hasGoals: boolean;
  hasRelationships: boolean;
  hasSchedule: boolean;
}

export interface OverviewDashboardResponse {
  lifeScore: OverviewLifeScore;
  pulse: OverviewPulse;
  dailyBrief: OverviewDailyBrief;
  priorities: OverviewPriority[];
  lifeAreas: OverviewLifeAreaSnapshot[];
  journey: OverviewJourneyItem[];
  dimensions: OverviewDimensionScore[];
  insights: OverviewInsight[];
  momentum: OverviewMomentum;
  coachPrompts: string[];
  featureSurfacing: OverviewFeatureChip[];
  // Life OS extensions (all additive; each is independently degradable)
  domains: OverviewDomainScore[];
  correlations: OverviewCorrelation[];
  relationships: OverviewRelationshipsSummary | null;
  finance: OverviewFinanceSummary | null;
  goals: OverviewGoalsSummary | null;
  schedule: OverviewScheduleItem[];
  meta: OverviewMeta;
}
```

```ts
export type UnifiedGoalStatus = 'active' | 'in_progress' | 'paused' | 'completed';

export interface UnifiedGoalDto {
  id: string;
  source: GoalSource;
  domain: string;
  title: string;
  description: string | null;
  progress: number;
  status: UnifiedGoalStatus;
  isPrimary: boolean;
  target?: { current: number; target: number; unit: string } | null;
  amount?: { current: number; target: number; currency?: string } | null;
  level?: { current: number; max: number } | null;
  cadence?: string | null;   // NOTE: this is target_unit (a measurement unit like "kg"), NOT a schedule
  dueDate?: string | null;
  editable: boolean;
  deepLink: string | null;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface UnifiedGoalsSummaryDto {
  total: number;
  active: number;
  inProgress: number;
  paused: number;
  completed: number;
  avgProgress: number;
  bySource: Record<GoalSource, number>;
}

export interface UnifiedGoalsResponseDto {
  goals: UnifiedGoalDto[];

}
```
